quest.513011087C06E9D8.quest_desc: Craft the MekaSuit boots using SOQM's JEI recipe. Prepare polonium pellets, HDPE, an induction cell and mythic-tier materials. This is a separate armor piece; its task does not require crafting the other three.

Charge the finished piece before using it. Install supported modules through a Modification Station; a plain Module Base has no ability of its own. The item task detects the boots without consuming it, rather than checking worn armor or installed modules.
quest.513011087C06E9D8.quest_subtitle: MekaSuit: four pieces and the tool
quest.513011087C06E9D8.title: MekaSuit: boots
quest.51301111493CFC21.quest_desc: Craft the MekaSuit bodyarmor using SOQM's JEI recipe. Prepare polonium pellets, HDPE, an induction cell and mythic-tier materials. This is a separate armor piece; its task does not require crafting the other three.

Charge the finished piece before using it. Install supported modules through a Modification Station; a plain Module Base has no ability of its own. The item task detects the bodyarmor without consuming it, rather than checking worn armor or installed modules.
quest.51301111493CFC21.quest_subtitle: MekaSuit: four pieces and the tool
quest.51301111493CFC21.title: MekaSuit: bodyarmor
quest.51301125CDBD7A23.quest_desc: A Silk Touch Unit makes supported blocks drop as themselves. Select the mode for the job; Silk Touch and Ore Refinement are not simultaneous bonuses to the same drop. Install the finished module in a Meka-Tool through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.51301125CDBD7A23.quest_subtitle: Meka-Tool modules and the maximum loadout
quest.51301125CDBD7A23.title: Silk Touch: the Meka-Tool module
quest.5130112F15810A47.quest_desc: Craft and charge a Meka-Tool. It is a separate tool, not a fifth MekaSuit armor piece. Crafting the base tool does not automatically add Silk Touch, Fortune or vein mining.

After building the Modification Station, follow the tool-module section below. This objective detects one Meka-Tool in inventory without consumption; the final native advancement checks actual maximum upgrades.
quest.5130112F15810A47.quest_subtitle: MekaSuit: four pieces and the tool
quest.5130112F15810A47.title: Meka-Tool: the modular tool
quest.51301132F9C95555.quest_desc: An Energy Unit increases storage capacity, but generates no power. Charge each item and add further copies only up to its supported limit. Install the finished module in a supported MekaSuit piece or Meka-Tool through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.51301132F9C95555.title: Energy Unit: energy capacity
quest.51301138646C9874.quest_desc: Place a Modification Station and supply FE. Put a supported MekaSuit piece or Meka-Tool in the equipment slot and a finished module in the upgrade slot. Wait for installation to finish; a module in your backpack is not installed.

Then open Module Tweaker using its Mekanism key binding in Controls. Select the equipment piece, enable the module and adjust its available settings. Check the station for supported modules and installed-copy limits.

This objective detects the station itself in inventory, so hold it before placing it at the base. Finished Unit quests also check items; the final objective separately verifies actual maximum upgrades.
quest.51301138646C9874.title: Modification Station: install modules
quest.5130113FB494C115.quest_desc: A Radiation Shielding Unit adds radiation protection to its particular armor piece. Prepare a module for every piece of a protected full set; one copy does not automatically protect the whole suit. Install the finished module in each of the four MekaSuit armor pieces through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.5130113FB494C115.title: Radiation Shielding: armor protection
quest.51301144D5FB95D4.quest_desc: An Electrolytic Breathing Unit extracts breathable oxygen from water and can replenish a Jetpack Unit's hydrogen when needed. Test it in shallow water with charged equipment. Install the finished module in a MekaSuit helmet through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.51301144D5FB95D4.title: Breathing Unit: underwater breathing
quest.51301155BDC855A3.quest_desc: A Vision Enhancement Unit improves visibility in darkness. Additional installed copies allow greater effectiveness within its limit; choose the operating setting explicitly. Install the finished module in a MekaSuit helmet through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.51301155BDC855A3.title: Vision Unit: night vision
quest.51301181BF058BAE.quest_desc: Craft the MekaSuit pants using SOQM's JEI recipe. Prepare polonium pellets, HDPE, an induction cell and mythic-tier materials. This is a separate armor piece; its task does not require crafting the other three.

Charge the finished piece before using it. Install supported modules through a Modification Station; a plain Module Base has no ability of its own. The item task detects the pants without consuming it, rather than checking worn armor or installed modules.
quest.51301181BF058BAE.quest_subtitle: MekaSuit: four pieces and the tool
quest.51301181BF058BAE.title: MekaSuit: pants
quest.513011C521E5B4DD.quest_desc: One Module Base requires 2 HDPE Sheets, 2 tin blocks, 2 bronze ingots, 2 Immersive Engineering steel plates and 1 Elite Control Circuit. Each recipe yields 1 blank, so multiple installed module copies need the corresponding number of bases.

The base is an intermediate part for a specific Unit. Choose the ability and a supported equipment piece, craft the finished module, then install it through the Modification Station. Limits vary by module: one copy is not always the maximum level.
quest.513011C521E5B4DD.title: Module Base: the upgrade blank
quest.513011CDE1D10A76.quest_desc: Craft the MekaSuit helmet using SOQM's JEI recipe. Prepare polonium pellets, HDPE, an induction cell and mythic-tier materials. This is a separate armor piece; its task does not require crafting the other three.

Charge the finished piece before using it. Install supported modules through a Modification Station; a plain Module Base has no ability of its own. The item task detects the helmet without consuming it, rather than checking worn armor or installed modules.
quest.513011CDE1D10A76.quest_subtitle: MekaSuit: four pieces and the tool
quest.513011CDE1D10A76.title: MekaSuit: helmet
quest.513011ED1A3D11E0.quest_desc: A Jetpack Unit adds a hydrogen-powered jetpack. Supply hydrogen and select its flight mode; the armor's electric charge does not replace that fuel. Install the finished module in MekaSuit bodyarmor through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.513011ED1A3D11E0.title: Jetpack Unit: hydrogen flight
quest.513011F1FC51AAE1.quest_desc: A Magnetic Attraction Unit pulls nearby dropped items towards you. It belongs in the boots, and extra copies increase its available range. Disable it near production lines that intentionally drop items into the world. Install the finished module in MekaSuit boots through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.513011F1FC51AAE1.title: Magnetic Unit: collect dropped items
quest.514C110000000001.quest_desc: Start the polymer line in a Pressurized Reaction Chamber. Supply 2 Bio Fuel, 10 mB water and 100 mB hydrogen to make 1 Substrate and 100 mB ethylene. A Crusher turns suitable plant material into Bio Fuel.

Extract both the solid Substrate and chemical ethylene. Reserve ethylene for the next step instead of burning the entire supply in a generator. The task detects one substrate in inventory without consumption; it does not inspect the processing line.
quest.514C110000000001.title: HDPE 1: substrate and ethylene
quest.514C110000000002.quest_desc: Condense ethylene into its fluid form in a Rotary Condensentrator. The next PRC reaction consumes 1 Substrate, 50 mB liquid ethylene and 10 mB oxygen to produce 1 HDPE Pellet.
Ethylene must use the fluid input here, while oxygen uses the chemical input. Match the pipes, Rotary mode and PRC sides to those resources. Keep producing: one HDPE Sheet needs three pellets.
quest.514C110000000002.title: HDPE 2: a polymer pellet
quest.514C110000000003.quest_desc: Place the MekaSuit helmet, bodyarmor, pants and boots together with a Meka-Tool in one inventory. Mekanism's native MekaSuit advancement checks exactly those five items.

This verifies possession of the complete item set, not worn armor or modules. Continue charging and choosing upgrades in the following sections; this optional loadout does not block reactors or the main route.
quest.514C110000000003.quest_subtitle: MekaSuit: four pieces and the tool
quest.514C110000000003.title: Full MekaSuit and Meka-Tool
quest.514C110000000004.quest_desc: Distributes charge between worn MekaSuit pieces. Supply power to the suit first: this module transfers energy between items rather than creating it. Install the finished module in MekaSuit bodyarmor through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C110000000004.title: Charge Distribution: shared armor charge
quest.514C110000000005.quest_desc: Displays your accumulated radiation dose in the HUD. This bodyarmor module measures exposure; it does not replace Radiation Shielding. Install the finished module in MekaSuit bodyarmor through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C110000000005.title: Dosimeter Unit: personal dose
quest.514C110000000006.quest_desc: Displays ambient radiation in the HUD. Compare it with the personal dose from a Dosimeter Unit: they measure different things, and measurement itself provides no shielding. Install the finished module in MekaSuit bodyarmor through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C110000000006.title: Geiger Unit: ambient radiation
quest.514C110000000007.quest_desc: Filters selected potion-effect categories through the breathing apparatus. Review its settings so useful beneficial effects are not removed. Install the finished module in a MekaSuit helmet through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C110000000007.title: Purification Unit: effect filtering
quest.514C110000000008.quest_desc: Increases sprint speed and jumping distance. Start with a low setting, check handling and power consumption, then install further copies. Install the finished module in MekaSuit pants through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C110000000008.title: Locomotive Unit: sprint speed
quest.514C110000000009.quest_desc: Allows higher stepping and jumping. Adjust the height to suit the passages in your base; installed copies determine the available levels. Install the finished module in MekaSuit boots through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C110000000009.title: Hydraulic Unit: stepping and jumping
quest.514C11000000000A.quest_desc: Adds an HDPE Reinforced Elytra to the suit. It provides gliding, so prepare a launch area and test it separately from jetpack and gravitational flight modes. Install the finished module in MekaSuit bodyarmor through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C11000000000A.title: Elytra Unit: armored gliding
quest.514C11000000000B.quest_desc: A Gravitational Modulating Unit enables free flight using energy. Its recipe requires antimatter and advanced induction infrastructure; complete the corresponding production line in chapter 08 first. Install the finished module in MekaSuit bodyarmor through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C11000000000B.title: Gravitational Unit: antimatter flight
quest.514C11000000000C.quest_desc: An Ore Refinement Unit increases yields from suitable ores. Configure it separately from Silk Touch and check drops on a small batch. Install the finished module in a Meka-Tool through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C11000000000C.quest_subtitle: Meka-Tool modules and the maximum loadout
quest.514C11000000000C.title: Ore Refinement: Meka-Tool Fortune
quest.514C11000000000D.quest_desc: Speeds up block breaking with the Meka-Tool. Raise the setting gradually and monitor power: maximum speed is not always useful when working beside machinery. Install the finished module in a Meka-Tool through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C11000000000D.quest_subtitle: Meka-Tool modules and the maximum loadout
quest.514C11000000000D.title: Excavation Unit: Meka-Tool speed
quest.514C11000000000E.quest_desc: Adds grouped ore mining and tree felling through the Meka-Tool. Choose the mode and range before testing it, separately from FTB Ultimine. Install the finished module in a Meka-Tool through a Modification Station, then check its enabled state and available settings in Module Tweaker.
This task requires one finished Unit in inventory without consumption. Completion does not prove installation or maximum level; those require modifying the equipment.
quest.514C11000000000E.quest_subtitle: Meka-Tool modules and the maximum loadout
quest.514C11000000000E.title: Vein Mining: grouped mining
quest.514C11000000000F.quest_desc: This is the optional True Dedication collection goal. Install the maximum number of every supported module in each of the four MekaSuit pieces and the Meka-Tool. The lessons above introduce key upgrades, but do not replace the complete supported-module list in the Modification Station.

The native advancement checks modules inside the items and their installed-copy counts, not loose Unit stacks in storage. Keep all five finished items in your inventory; if the advancement does not appear, inspect each piece and every limit separately.
This maximum upgrade is not required to start reactors, manufacture EMC or finish Main Route. Choose a practical module loadout first and treat the fully upgraded set as a separate project.
quest.514C11000000000F.quest_subtitle: Meka-Tool modules and the maximum loadout
quest.514C11000000000F.title: Maximum MekaSuit and Meka-Tool upgrades

quest.514D11E17AB94DF9.quest_desc: An Enrichment Chamber processes 3 HDPE Pellets into 1 HDPE Sheet. The existing objective requires 8 sheets, so prepare 24 pellets and steady power.

Sheets supply MekaSuit, Module Bases and the Modification Station. A separate SOQM recipe also converts 1 HDPE Sheet into 3 Industrial Foregoing Plastic; chapter 10 continues that plastic route. This task detects sheets in inventory without consuming them.
quest.514D11E17AB94DF9.title: HDPE 3: sheets
